verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a single search call (searchMode: hybrid, client.search) that returns relevant memories/document chunks plus optional related-memory graph traversal and always-ready user profiles, which functions as a one-call context retrieval mechanism. However, there is no documented token-budget parameter or explicit 'prompt-ready assembled context block' output format — retrieval returns raw chunks/memories rather than a formatted, budget-constrained prompt string. missing for 10: explicit token-budget/limit control on the retrieval call, evidence of a pre-formatted prompt-ready context block output, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact one-call assembly behavior.
